title: GSK3beta-dependent lysosome biogenesis: An effective pathway to mitigate renal fibrosis with LM49.
authors: Ren, Jinhong; Wei, Huizhi; Sun, Jian; Feng, Xiue; Zhang, Yuanlin; Yuan, Hongxia; Miao, Junqiu; Qi, Xiaoming; Qiao, Yuanbiao; Xiao, Baoguo; Li, Qingshan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子LM49通过抑制GSK3beta促进TFEB核转位和溶酶体生成以缓解肾纤维化，虽涉及TFEB转录因子和分子动力学模拟，但核心是药物-激酶互作而非蛋白质-DNA结合，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: Renal fibrosis is an incurable disorder characterised by an imbalance of the extracellular matrix (ECM) favouring excess production over degradation. The identification of actionable pathways and agents that promote ECM degradation to restore ECM homeostasis may help mitigate renal fibrosis. In this study, we identified 5,2'-dibromo-2,4',5'-trihydroxydiphenylmethanone (LM49), a compound we previously synthesised, as a small-molecule inducer of ECM degradation. LM49 administration efficiently reduced ECM deposition in renal tissue of diabetic nephropathy rats and in transforming growth factor beta-treated renal fibroblast cells. LM49 promoted the cytosol-to-nucleus translocation of transcription factor EB (TFEB) to increase lysosome biogenesis, leading to lysosome-based degradation of the ECM. TFEB-mediated lysosome biogenesis was induced by LM49 directly inhibiting the activity of glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (GSK3beta) rather than mammalian target of rapamycin complex 1. LM49 inhibited GSK3beta kinase activity concentration-dependently via competing with ATP. Direct binding between LM49 and GSK3beta was confirmed by the bio-layer interferometry assay, cellular thermal shift assay, and drug affinity responsive target stability. A molecular docking and molecular dynamic simulation revealed that LM49 occupied the ATP pocket of GSK3beta, which was consistent with the kinase activity assay. In summary, LM49 enhances TFEB-mediated lysosome biogenesis by directly inhibiting GSK3beta, leading to the degradation of the ECM by lysosomes. The enhancement of GSK3beta-dependent lysosome biogenesis to rebalance the ECM may be a novel strategy to counteract renal fibrosis, and LM49 may be a viable clinical candidate for treating this disorder.
abstract_zh: 肾纤维化是一种无法治愈的疾病，其特征是细胞外基质（ECM）失衡，表现为生成超过降解。识别可操作的途径和促进ECM降解以恢复ECM稳态的药物，可能有助于缓解肾纤维化。在本研究中，我们鉴定出5,2'-二溴-2,4',5'-三羟基二苯甲酮（LM49），一种我们先前合成的化合物，作为ECM降解的小分子诱导剂。LM49给药有效减少了糖尿病肾病大鼠肾组织及转化生长因子β处理的肾成纤维细胞中的ECM沉积。LM49促进转录因子EB（TFEB）从胞质向核转位，以增加溶酶体生物发生，从而介导基于溶酶体的ECM降解。TFEB介导的溶酶体生物发生是由LM49直接抑制糖原合酶激酶3β（GSK3β）活性而非哺乳动物雷帕霉素靶蛋白复合物1所诱导。LM49通过竞争ATP浓度依赖性地抑制GSK3β激酶活性。LM49与GSK3β之间的直接结合通过生物层干涉测定、细胞热位移测定和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性实验得到确认。分子对接和分子动力学模拟显示，LM49占据GSK3β的ATP口袋，这与激酶活性测定结果一致。总之，LM49通过直接抑制GSK3β增强TFEB介导的溶酶体生物发生，导致溶酶体降解ECM。增强GSK3β依赖性溶酶体生物发生以重新平衡ECM可能是对抗肾纤维化的新策略，而LM49可能是治疗该疾病的可行临床候选药物。
